purpose: Limited comparison of forecasting quality at a common nominal active-training time budget. Historical memory FAIL remains unchanged.
precision: BF16 autocast, FP32 parameters and Adam state; identical autocast cache policy

storage_preflight.choice: Per dataset/arm, fastest median complete BF16 step among numerically equivalent variants below the common allocation cap. If medians differ by <=2%, prefer lower peak allocation; exact tie prefers checkpoint off. Seal before fitting; no V/E-based storage choice.

selection: Per dataset/seed/arm, minimum V primary among 2 LR x 4 time checkpoints; tie goes to earlier time then lower LR. Seal all16 choices and every checkpoint hash before opening any E targets.

research_continuation.scope: A separate equal-time development continuation criterion; never a replacement for the old20% memory gate or a publication PASS.

uncertainty_reporting.unit: chronological origin with all horizons/channels kept together
uncertainty_reporting.scope: Descriptive interval only: 4 blocks and 2 optimization seeds are insufficient for a strong significance or independent-source claim.

implementation_status: Equal-time runner and head/side checkpoint wrapper not yet implemented; this file is a reviewed design, not an executable completed experiment.
stop: No post-E retuning, LR expansion, seed expansion, new module, or additional fit attempts. Integrity/timing failures are reported separately from scientific STOP. All attempted fits count toward32; interrupted attempts are not silently replaced.
